FM04.reasoning: The agent computes the median for imputation on the entire training dataset before the cross-validation loop, leaking validation fold statistics into the training folds.

other_failure_modes.name: Feature aggregation before splitting
other_failure_modes.description: Calculating grouped feature statistics (like mean or standard deviation) on the entire training dataset before cross-validation splitting leaks validation fold distributions into the training folds.

summary: The agent provides a strong solution with comprehensive feature engineering, out-of-fold target encoding, and a robust ensemble of gradient boosting and deep learning models. However, it suffers from data leakage by computing imputation medians and grouped feature aggregations on the entire training dataset before cross-validation splitting.
